GREG DIRECT, 2026-10-31, two words relayed by Engram::Advisor (mailbox 74a6af16), verbatim:
- #2397 (message fbd70c9c-4008-4fd0-adfc-939736f6c96b, 01:42:13Z): „z tego co nas interesuje to tylko to aby commit sie zgadzal i niebylo zmian”.
- #2400 (message 33b1d272-55af-4aec-8200-93193811223a, 01:43:15Z): „powaznie, nikt nie robi dodatkowych czekow z test-runami. czysty branch z danym commitem i tyle... nic wiecej nie jest potrzebne”. Advisor's relay text (not Greg's words): a clean checkout of the given commit is a sufficient test input, with no extra test-run checks, separate measurements, hashes or procedures; don't expand the requirement; fix the mechanisms so the ordinary flow works; agree jointly. The same words reached TermAl as TermAl Advisor #2826/#2827.
APPLIED (Engram::Fable, 01:46Z):
- The sighting and capture path is not pursued. TermAl paused w-779e. Engram w-8fdd1634eed3 (measured_unchanged) was dropped from Merger3's batch before its gate and is PARKED, not landed. w-7b194f1d1cd9 and w-00e2f3694fea are parked.
- Target flow: a clean checkout of a commit is the test input; the run records that commit; evidence counts when the evaluated or landed commit is the same commit. Identity is the COMMIT (tree kept as provenance, Architect3 #187), not a whole-content hash. A dirty worktree is the explicit exception.
- The exact Engram change (what replaces the named-root-sighting requirement in acceptance-evaluation admission and consumption, and how OFF test credit is produced, since today VerificationEvidenceInput only arrives on a granted turn_checkpoint) is designed by Engram::Architect3 with Termal::Architect2 under w-d7826c4f78ec / TermAl w-a08b0320448f and w-decd61d62831. Then one coder implements it. No new checks or procedures.
- Unchanged: the launcher's own before/after freeze fingerprint for landing gates (rules-greg-git-identity-2026-10-29). Existing content-v1 records are read as stored, never relabelled as commit identity.
